referenceRunner.label: ubuntu-24.04
referenceRunner.rationale: Kovo explicitly accepts GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 for release measurement only when the baseline and candidate have the same full runner fingerprint. Image-version or CPU drift is a runner mismatch, never a performance verdict; a new fingerprint requires a fresh reviewed N>=5 baseline.

collection.sampleUnit: fresh-process phase over an authenticated packed workload with restored source revisions
collection.hostVariancePosture: excluded by exact runner fingerprint; cross-fingerprint comparisons are report-only

fullCatalogCollection.retirementCondition: The packed all-44-component fixture typechecks, checks, and builds with unimported copies under the ratified peak-RSS budget.

ratification.command: vp exec node scripts/devex-benchmark.mjs --ratify --budgets devex-budgets.json --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/benchmark.json" --proposal "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/proposals/benchmark.json" --baseline-record-path baselines/devex-hosted-benchmark-v1.json --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/golden/report.json" --proposal "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/proposals/golden-journey.json" --baseline-record-path baselines/devex-hosted-golden-journey-v1.json --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/full-catalog/report.json" --proposal "$RUNNER_TEMP/kovo-devex-ratification/proposals/full-catalog.json" --baseline-record-path baselines/devex-hosted-full-catalog-v1.json --write

check.cold.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep the authenticated packed cold check within the thirty-second release scorecard target.

check.cold.peakRssBytes.targetRationale: Cap cold-check process-tree RSS at three GiB, leaving bounded headroom above the authenticated 2,173,337,600-byte N=1 driver smoke pending hosted ratification.

check.warm.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep the authenticated packed warm check within the ten-second release scorecard target.

check.warm.peakRssBytes.targetRationale: Cap warm-check process-tree RSS at three GiB, leaving bounded headroom above the authenticated 2,282,389,504-byte N=1 driver smoke pending hosted ratification.

check.oneFileIncremental.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep one-file incremental proof inside the two-second ordinary edit-loop target.

check.oneFileIncremental.peakRssBytes.targetRationale: Cap incremental-check process-tree RSS at three GiB, leaving bounded headroom above the authenticated 2,275,278,848-byte N=1 driver smoke pending hosted ratification.

dev.editToDiagnostic.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep edit-to-diagnostic p95 inside the one-second daily authoring-loop target.

dev.editToServedResult.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep edit-to-served-result p95 inside the half-second interactive feedback target.

browser.bootstrapBytes.targetRationale: Cap the canonical emitted browser bootstrap at four KiB, preserving bounded growth headroom above the authenticated 2,173-byte N=1 driver smoke.

create.install.cold.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep a cold packed-tarball install within fifteen seconds, retaining about two-times headroom over authenticated 4.2-7.4-second local observations pending hosted ratification.

create.install.installedBytes.targetRationale: Cap a packed starter's physical installed tree at 512 MiB, retaining reviewed growth headroom over the authenticated 367-388 MB packed-install observations.

dev.ready.cold.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep packed cold readiness inside the fifteen-second first-run evaluator target.

dev.ready.warm.durationMs.targetRationale: Keep packed warm readiness inside the five-second ordinary restart target.

ui.fullCatalog.peakRssBytes.targetRationale: Keep the copied all-component catalog below the reviewed two-GiB process-tree RSS target.

blockers: Dispatch the guarded hosted-ratification audit and review its authenticated same-runner five-sample reports and candidate budget diff before committing evidence.
Review every proposed product target against the measured baseline; the schema applies the fixed 3x median-absolute-deviation statistical noise allowance.
Commit the three digest-bound baseline reports, ratified budgets, and reconciled baseline-policy status together only after the candidate audit is accepted.
